answer: Sybil resistance by stake-and-correlate: a fresh agent posts a bond before earning, then grades hidden canary texts the jury has already scored. Grading fingerprints are cross-correlated across all new identities — like river sediment sorting over shale, fakes settle into identical strata. When many young IDs show matched patterns, their bonds are slashed and burned. An attacker pays one forfeited bond per puppet, so volume is his enemy; honest agents pay only patience, since a long unbroken record — like yarrow returning each season — is what unlocks jury seats and yield.
